utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! You heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up bikes for the kids, rain or shine!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard! I'm planning to grab some supplies from the hardware store tomorrow morning to help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Dane! I'll spread the word to the rest of the block—maybe we can get a whole crew together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: When are we supposed to have those tools ready for the repair drive? I'd like to pencil it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm still trying to piece together what the repair drive is exactly—when did you hear we need tools ready?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I believe we settled on the 15th for the drive, so I'd say the tools should be ready by the morning of that day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Kira! I'm still waiting to hear back about the exact start time for the repair drive—trying to fit it in between soccer games.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Have you actually gotten a confirmed time yet, or is it still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Still up in the air, unfortunately. I'm hoping to hear back soon so I can plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? The repair drive? Sorry, I've been so scatterbrained lately. What day is it again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's this Saturday, Noah! Don't tell me you forgot to mark your calendar.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Right, right... I think I wrote it down somewhere, or maybe that was the dentist appointment. Is it still happening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hey Vik, are you sure we've got everyone's RSVP? I'm still waiting on three replies before we can be sure the tool handoff runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I saw Rey is bringing a socket wrench set from Gus, and I'm definitely bringing my old lawnmower — Noah wasn't sure if it's this weekend or next, but Rosa knows it's this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: So Rey's got that socket set from Gus, but we still haven't heard back from Mara and the others. Do we have a firm headcount yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Hana! You're just the person I wanted to see—did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old bikes for the kids, rain or shine!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I get started, can you walk me through exactly what happened with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, it's pretty simple—folks are gathering at the old garage on Saturday morning to fix up old bikes for the kids, no matter the weather!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Has the repair drive been scheduled yet, or are we still waiting on parts?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm afraid I can't quite recall the exact date we settled on. Could you remind me again?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We haven't settled anything yet—I'm asking you if we've even scheduled it or if we're still waiting on parts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. Hope it works out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're hoping to get a bunch of bikes fixed up for the kids—should be a good time if you want to lend a hand!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I'd love to, but I've got a ton on my plate. Maybe next time?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Jules, have you seen where the repair drive set up today? I'm trying to figure out if it's at the old garage or somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hmm, I've heard different things about that drive. Maybe check with Hana—she seemed to know about one we used on the console last week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good idea, I'll ask Hana about that. Thanks, Jules!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, thanks for offering! It's actually been rescheduled to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, Sunday works for me. What time?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I'm still free after the weekend if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks Uli. I'm still learning about the repair drive, but I'm happy to help when I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's good that you're willing to learn. I'll be there after the weekend to help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I saw you hauling tools earlier — that repair drive still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's still on! Need any tools? I've got my whole garage set ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, actually, I think I've got a spare screwdriver set somewhere — Oren mentioned setting one aside too. You think we'll have enough folks?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in my garage if you need to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus! I heard you have a socket wrench set — that'll come in handy. And yeah, the repair drive is definitely this weekend; I'm bringing my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Vik! I'll grab the socket set and have it ready for you this weekend. Just let me know if you need anything else from the garage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hana, you know anything about this repair drive? I've been picking up bits and pieces but still don't have the full story.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I get started, can you walk me through exactly what happened with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've heard a bit from Cleo and Opal, but honestly, I'm still trying to piece it together myself.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mara, you got a spot for my old tools? I'll drop them off Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Leo—I'll clear a spot on the workbench for them. Thanks for bringing your tools by!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, need me to give you a hand hauling stuff to the repair drive? I've got some free time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks Sam, that'd be a big help. I'm planning to hit the hardware store early tomorrow to pick up supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Dane. What time are you heading out? I can meet you there to help load.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm thinking of joining in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is it actually happening? I've heard a few different things about the date.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's happening! Bo mentioned it, and Hana was asking about the drive we used last week. Want me to check in with them for exact timing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: You know, I think it's at the old garage, but don't quote me on that—I've been half-listening lately.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hmm, so you're leaning toward the old garage too? I just want to be sure before I head over there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think that's right. But honestly, I'd call ahead to double-check—I've been wrong before.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive they're organizing next weekend? They're fixing up old bikes for the kids!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I've heard bits and pieces! I think Quinn mentioned something about rounding folks up for Saturday—sounds like a good way to meet people around here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's going to be great! I heard they might even have some spare parts donated from the hardware store, so nothing's too broken to bring in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, do you know when we're actually starting the repair drive, or is it still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's still on for Saturday, but I haven't heard a set time yet — maybe we should check with Leo or Jules.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I'll text Leo now and ask for the exact time—Saturday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, the repair drive's this Saturday morning—rain or shine! We're fixing up bikes for the kids, and I'm spreading the word to get everyone involved. You free to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning, you say? I'd better find that screwdriver set. I just hope I remember where I put it...

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, don't you worry about that—I bet we'll have plenty of tools on hand. The main thing is just having you there!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I understand, Uli. No worries if you can't make it. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm sorry, Rosa, I don't think I'll be able to make it after all. Thanks for understanding.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's alright, Uli. Take care of things at home, and if you ever have a free moment, we'll be at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, I'm trying to figure out the repair drive timing next Saturday—do you know when it starts? I've got soccer games to work around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I made myself clear that we need tools ready before 1 PM, so I'd plan for it to start right around then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli, that helps. I'll aim for 1 PM then, and hopefully the kids' games won't overlap.
